VitalSignBp.preprocessSql: select * from VitalSignBp where MeetMoment LIKE '$year%'

source.preprocessSql: select Pseudo_id,Patientcontactid,MeetDatum,MAX(CASE WHEN LOINCcode = '8302-2' THEN ValueQuantity END) AS Height_cm,MAX(CASE WHEN LOINCcode = '29463-7' THEN ValueQuantity END) AS Weight_kg,MAX(CASE WHEN LOINCcode = '89270-3' THEN ValueQuantity END) AS BMI FROM source GROUP BY Pseudo_id,Patientcontactid,MeetDatum

select * from source where LOINC_code != '89579-7' and LOINC_code != '10839-9' and LOINC_code != '67151-1' and LOINC_code != '6598-7' and year(MateriaalAfnameDatumTijd) = $year and month(MateriaalAfnameDatumTijd) = $month

select count(*) as count, Pseudo_id, EcgMetingId,
array_agg(EcgAfnameDatumTijd) as EcgAfnameDatumTijd,
array_agg(ValueQuantity) as ValueQuantity,
array_agg(LOINCcode) as LOINCcode,
array_agg(LOINCdisplay) as LOINCdisplay
from source 
where ValueQuantity != 0 AND NOT (LOINCcode = '8633-0' AND ValueQuantity > 300) AND Pseudo_id % 3 = INT($remainder)
group by Pseudo_id, EcgMetingId

select * 
from source
where ATCCode != '' and AdministeredAmount IS NOT NULL

select DISTINCT * 
from source
where StartDate > '1900-01-01'

select *
from source 
where nyha IN (1, 2, 3, 4)

select count(*) as count, pseudo_id, Accessionnummer,
array_agg(Onderzoeksdatum) as Onderzoeksdatum,
array_agg(ValueQuantity) as ValueQuantity,
array_agg(UNIT) as UNIT,
array_agg(LOINCcode) as LOINCcode,
array_agg(LOINCdisplay) as LOINCdisplay
from source 
where LOINCcode is not null
group by pseudo_id, Accessionnummer
select DISTINCT VerrichtingId, pseudo_id, Verrichtingdatum, ICD10PCS, ProcedureCategory from source where ICD10PCS IS NOT NULL
